<documents>
<document id="atm-limits">
ATMˆwithdrawalˆlimitsˆHowˆmuchˆcashˆyouˆcanˆtakeˆoutˆeachˆdayˆdependsˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆTheˆlimitˆcoversˆallˆATMsˆcombined,ˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆabroad.ˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆATMˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$1,500ˆ|ˆTheˆdailyˆlimitˆresetsˆatˆmidnightˆEasternˆTime.ˆ##ˆCanˆIˆraiseˆmyˆlimit?ˆNo.ˆLimitsˆareˆsetˆbyˆplan,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆraiseˆthemˆforˆaˆdayˆorˆmakeˆexceptions.ˆTheˆonlyˆwayˆtoˆgetˆaˆhigherˆlimitˆisˆtoˆchangeˆplan.ˆ##ˆATMˆlimitsˆversusˆtheˆATM'sˆownˆlimitˆManyˆATMsˆhaveˆtheirˆownˆmaximumˆperˆwithdrawalˆthat'sˆlowerˆthanˆours.ˆIfˆyouˆneedˆmore,ˆyouˆcanˆmakeˆmoreˆthanˆoneˆwithdrawal,ˆasˆlongˆasˆtheˆtotalˆstaysˆwithinˆyourˆdailyˆlimit.ˆEachˆwithdrawalˆoutsideˆBrookLinkˆmayˆcarryˆaˆfee.ˆCashˆwithdrawalsˆareˆneverˆcoveredˆbyˆCushion.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="plans-compare">
Compareˆplans:ˆfeaturesˆandˆlimitsˆAllˆthreeˆplansˆcomeˆwithˆaˆVisaˆdebitˆcard,ˆtheˆTallowbrookˆapp,ˆBrookPayˆtransfersˆtoˆotherˆmembers,ˆSavingsˆPocketsˆandˆsupportˆaroundˆtheˆclock.ˆTheyˆdifferˆinˆfees,ˆlimitsˆandˆaˆfewˆfeatures.ˆ|ˆFeatureˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆCardˆ|ˆplasticˆ|ˆplasticˆ|ˆmetalˆ|ˆ|ˆSavingsˆAPYˆ|ˆ0.50%ˆ|ˆ2.00%ˆ|ˆ3.75%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCushionˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆ|ˆupˆtoˆ$200ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆcardˆspendingˆ|ˆ$3,000ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆ|ˆ$500ˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ$1,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆDailyˆACHˆtransfersˆoutˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwiresˆ|ˆnotˆavailableˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆ|ˆEmergencyˆcardˆabroadˆ|ˆnoˆ|ˆnoˆ|ˆyesˆ|ˆFeesˆareˆlistedˆinˆtheˆarticleˆ"Feesˆforˆallˆplans".ˆThisˆpageˆcoversˆfeaturesˆandˆlimitsˆonly.ˆ##ˆWhichˆplanˆfitsˆBasicˆsuitsˆpeopleˆwhoˆmostlyˆuseˆBrookLinkˆATMsˆandˆdon'tˆtravel.ˆPlusˆsuitsˆpeopleˆwhoˆwantˆCushionˆandˆaˆbetterˆsavingsˆrateˆforˆaˆsmallˆmonthlyˆfee.ˆPremiumˆsuitsˆfrequentˆtravelersˆandˆpeopleˆwithˆlargerˆbalances,ˆsinceˆtheˆsavingsˆrateˆandˆtheˆmissingˆforeignˆfeesˆcanˆmoreˆthanˆcoverˆtheˆmonthlyˆfee.ˆYouˆcanˆswitchˆplansˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆtime.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="card-declined">
Whyˆwasˆmyˆcardˆdeclined?ˆIfˆaˆpurchaseˆwasˆdeclined,ˆtheˆappˆusuallyˆtellsˆyouˆwhyˆinˆtheˆactivityˆfeed.ˆTheseˆareˆtheˆmostˆcommonˆreasons.ˆ##ˆNotˆenoughˆmoneyˆWeˆdon'tˆletˆyourˆbalanceˆgoˆnegativeˆonˆmostˆtransactions,ˆsoˆaˆpurchaseˆlargerˆthanˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆdeclined.ˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆforˆthat.ˆPlusˆandˆPremiumˆmembersˆwithˆCushionˆmayˆbeˆcoveredˆforˆsmallˆdebitˆcardˆpurchases.ˆ##ˆYourˆdailyˆlimitˆDailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimitsˆareˆ$3,000ˆonˆBasic,ˆ$5,000ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ$10,000ˆonˆPremium.ˆLimitsˆcan'tˆbeˆraisedˆexceptˆbyˆchangingˆplan.ˆ##ˆCardˆsettingsˆCheckˆthatˆtheˆcardˆisˆactivatedˆandˆisn'tˆfrozen,ˆandˆthatˆtheˆrightˆcontrolsˆareˆon.ˆIfˆinternationalˆpurchasesˆareˆswitchedˆoff,ˆforeignˆmerchantsˆwillˆdecline,ˆevenˆforˆonlineˆorders.ˆ##ˆFraudˆchecksˆIfˆourˆsystemsˆthinkˆaˆpurchaseˆlooksˆunusual,ˆweˆdeclineˆitˆandˆsendˆaˆfraudˆalert.ˆConfirmˆtheˆalertˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆtryˆagain.ˆIfˆyouˆdon'tˆanswer,ˆtheˆcardˆmayˆstayˆlocked.ˆ##ˆWhereˆyouˆareˆCardsˆdon'tˆworkˆinˆcomprehensivelyˆsanctionedˆcountriesˆandˆregions.ˆIfˆnoneˆofˆtheseˆexplainˆit,ˆmessageˆsupportˆwithˆtheˆmerchantˆnameˆandˆtimeˆofˆtheˆpurchase.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
